name: OEDRO Three Raised Running Boards Compatible with 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra Crewmax Cab. Bed Access Side Steps, Bolt-on Heavy-Duty Carbon Steel Nerf Bar Side Rails Rock Sliders
fitment: Compatible with 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra CrewMax Cab.

description:
Upgrade your 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra CrewMax Cab with OEDRO Heavy-Duty 3-Step Running Boards, engineered to combine rugged protection, everyday convenience, and aggressive off-road styling. Designed with a unique triple-raised step system, these side steps provide easy access to the cab, truck bed, and roof while making towing, hauling, camping, and daily driving more convenient.
Constructed from high-strength carbon steel with a reinforced triangular structure, these running boards are built for demanding environments and support up to 550 lbs per side. The wide 6.8-inch polygonal steel tube design delivers excellent durability while adding a powerful off-road appearance to your Tundra.
The integrated 3.5-inch drop step creates a comfortable stepping height, while the textured perforated surface enhances grip and prevents water, mud, and snow buildup. Whether you're upgrading your work truck or preparing for outdoor adventures, OEDRO running boards deliver the perfect balance of accessibility, protection, and style.
Features
Perfect Fit for Toyota Tundra CrewMax Cab: Designed specifically for 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 Toyota Tundra CrewMax Cab models with 4 full-size doors, these running boards provide a precise bolt-on fit. Please confirm your cab style before purchase to ensure compatibility.
Triple Raised Step Design for Maximum Accessibility: Featuring integrated front, center, and rear step platforms, these running boards offer convenient access to the cab, truck bed, and roof area. The multi-step layout makes loading cargo, towing, camping, and daily driving easier and more practical.
Heavy-Duty Carbon Steel Construction: Built with a reinforced triangular structure and premium carbon steel tubing, these side steps deliver exceptional strength and durability. The rugged powder-coated finish provides long-lasting protection against rust, corrosion, and harsh outdoor conditions while supporting up to 550 lbs per side.
6.8-Inch Wide Drop Step with Aggressive Off-Road Style: The 3.5-inch drop step design combined with a 6.8-inch wide polygonal steel tube creates a bold off-road appearance while improving stepping comfort. Designed to provide enhanced protection from road debris, rocks, and daily impacts without sacrificing ground clearance.
Anti-Slip Surface for All-Weather Safety: The perforated step surface improves traction by allowing water, mud, dirt, and snow to drain away quickly. These durable nerf bars provide secure footing in all weather conditions, making them ideal for work trucks, outdoor adventures, and family vehicles.
1-Year Warranty | Professional installation is highly recommended for safety.
Fitment
Compatible with 2022-2026 Toyota Tundra CrewMax Cab.
